summary: This is the Dawn demo store, so the catalogue is small and tidy: 32 priced products with 8 to 25 images each, real descriptions, and compare-at prices that are always above the price. The gaps are housekeeping: sold-out items leading the home page, a Sale collection that is not about sales, blank product types and SKUs, and no image alt text.
strengths: Every product has at least 5 images (min 5, max 25) and a description of at least 371 characters (shop/products.json)
Only 29 of 266 variants (5 products) carry a compare-at price, and none is equal to or below the price, so the sale badge keeps its meaning (shop/catalogue-stats.json)
The announcement bar, product page and shipping page all say shipping is free, so there is no threshold to compare to the median price of 460 CAD (pages/home/text.txt)
Add to cart clicks on the 5 tested product pages added the right product, and no upsell interrupted the purchase (clicktest/results.json)

findings.title: Three of the first four products on the home page are marked "Sold out"
see_it: Scroll to the featured product grid below "Shop now"
The cards read: Small Convertible Flex Bag "Sold out", Studio Bag "Sold out", Louise Slide Sandal (on sale), Mini Naomi Bag "Sold out"

evidence.note: first four product cards: three carry "Sold out"
soldOutProducts lists studio-denim, mini-naomi-bag-harvest, small-convertible-flex-bag-cappuccino, thelma-sandal (4 of 32)

findings.why_it_matters: The most prominent products a new visitor sees cannot be bought, so the top of the home page shows little that is purchasable. Visitors from ads or search who click a sold-out card hit a dead end. This is a public demo store, so the selection may be left as is on purpose.

fix.summary: Keep sold-out items out of the first row of the home featured collection, or reorder it so in-stock best sellers lead.
steps: Open the collection used by the home page featured section (Homepage Featured Collection)
Set sort to manual or best selling, and move in-stock products to the top
Optionally hide sold-out products with the collection's availability filter

findings.claude_prompt: On the Shopify store https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com, the home page featured collection (handle frontpage) leads with three sold-out products: Small Convertible Flex Bag, Studio Bag, Mini Naomi Bag. Using the Shopify connector, list the collection's products with availability and propose a new manual order putting in-stock products first. Do not apply changes until I approve the list.
findings.verify_fix: Reload the home page on a phone: the first four cards all show a price and none says "Sold out".

findings.title: The "Sale" collection holds the same 26 products as "Bags", but only 4 of them have a sale price
see_it: Count products with a compare-at price: 4 of 26

evidence.note: sale 26 products / 4 with compare-at; bags 26 / 4; featured-collection-2 26 / 4
"sale" and "featured-collection-2" are separate collections next to "bags"

findings.why_it_matters: A shopper who opens Sale expects discounted items and finds 22 full-price ones, which weakens the meaning of the page. The same pattern affects "Featured collection 2". The collections are not in the main menu (Bags, Shoes, Lookbook), so only shoppers with a direct link meet it.

fix.summary: Make Sale an automated collection with the condition "compare-at price is greater than 0".
steps: Condition: Compare at price is greater than 0
Rename or delete "Featured collection 2" if it is unused

findings.claude_prompt: In the Shopify store https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com, the collection Sale (handle sale) contains all 26 bags though only 4 have a compare-at price. Convert it to an automated collection with condition Compare at price > 0, show me the resulting product list before saving, and report any theme section that links to it.
findings.verify_fix: Open /collections/sale: every product shows a Regular price and a Sale price.

findings.title: 26 of 32 products have an empty product type, and tags mix styles and technical entries
see_it: Check product_type: only the 6 shoes say "Shoes"; the 26 bags are blank
Check tags: "Crossbody" and "Shoulder" next to "mini" and "handle", and one tag reads "__with:wave-wallet-black-gray" (Business Bag)

evidence.note: product_type blank on 26 of 32; tags include "__with:wave-wallet-black-gray"

findings.why_it_matters: Product type feeds Google Shopping, collection rules and reporting, so a blank type on 81% of products limits filtering and feeds. Tags that mix size, shape and style make rule-based collections harder to keep clean.

fix.summary: Fill product type (Handbag, Wallet, Shoes) and use one tag vocabulary.
steps: Bulk edit Products: add Product type
Agree a tag list (shape, size, style) and apply it
Leave the "__with:" tag if a theme or app reads it

findings.claude_prompt: For https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com, 26 of 32 products have an empty product_type. Using the Shopify connector, propose a product type for each (Handbag, Wallet, Case) from title and tags as a table. Do not write anything until I approve it.

findings.title: All 419 product images have no alt text
see_it: In every product's images list, alt is null (419 of 419 images across 32 products)
findings.why_it_matters: Screen-reader users hear nothing for product photos, and Google Images gets no text description. On a visual catalogue of bags and shoes this is the main text signal for image search.

fix.summary: Add short alt text to the images, starting with the first image of each product.
steps: Add in bulk via the Shopify GraphQL productUpdateMedia or a bulk editor app
fix.where_to_change: Products > product > Media > Edit alt text

findings.claude_prompt: In the Shopify store https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com, all 419 product images have empty alt text. Draft alt text for the main image of each of the 32 products (product title, colour, view) as a table, in the store's tone, for me to review before any write.
findings.verify_fix: products.json shows alt text on the images.

findings.title: 11 of 32 products have variants with no SKU, including all 6 shoes
see_it: Count variants with a blank sku: 159 of 266, on 11 products, e.g. louise-slide-sandal, thelma-sandal, otti-combat-boot, helix-denim
findings.why_it_matters: These are physical goods, so stock, returns and warehouse picking depend on a code per size. Blank SKUs make inventory counts and order matching harder. A demo store may leave them blank deliberately.

fix.summary: Add a SKU to each variant of the 11 products.
steps: Fill Variant SKU using the factory pattern used by the other products

findings.claude_prompt: For https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com, 159 variants on 11 products have no SKU. List them in a table with handle and variant title and propose SKUs following the pattern of the existing ones (e.g. 10-039-065). Do not write to the store.
findings.verify_fix: products.json shows a sku on every variant.

findings.title: Sold-out products stay listed: Thelma Sandal has 0 of 42 variants available, and Louise Slide Sandal 7 of 21
see_it: Pick sizes: many options show "Variant sold out or unavailable"

evidence.note: Louise Slide Sandal: size buttons flagged "Variant sold out or unavailable"

findings.why_it_matters: Shoppers who pick a favourite size may find it gone, and a fully sold-out product still ranks in collections. Missing sizes push people to leave rather than buy another colour.

fix.summary: Add "Notify me when back in stock" on sold-out variants, or hide fully sold-out products from collections.
steps: Hide sold-out products using the collection availability filter
Add a back-in-stock alert app or Klaviyo form

findings.claude_prompt: On https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com/products/thelma-sandal every variant is unavailable. Suggest the smallest theme change in a duplicate theme to show a back-in-stock sign-up on sold-out product pages. Show the diff and do not publish.
findings.verify_fix: Sold-out product pages offer an alert sign-up; fully sold-out products no longer sit among in-stock ones.

handoffs.note: Product image alt text is empty on all 419 images; policy URLs /policies/refund-policy and /policies/shipping-policy return 404 while /pages/shipping-returns exists.

Announcement bar says free shipping on all orders, the shipping page says "We ship all US domestic orders within 5-10 business days" while the store sells in CAD and product pages say 1-4 days after shipment; worth reconciling delivery times.
